observes: Failure scenario S6, licence refusal at product level (IRIS Community 2026.1, 8 units, AUDITE, product used through IRISGraphEngine.from_connect and its ledger API). World C (control, units free): the engine's first native call opened its dedicated connection; commits seq 2 and 3, 51 edge rows, parameterised reads correct, verify equal. World X (7 holders took every free unit after the engine connected; the next connect refused 'Unable to allocate a license'): the dedicated connect was refused and the engine fell back to the caller's connection without any log line (native_conn_dedicated false); commits still all-or-nothing (51 rows), reads correct, verify equal, but each native call retried the refused connect (~2 s per commit vs 0.2 s); filed F-C1795 (S4). World R (8 holders, every unit taken before connecting): from_connect refused with the licence error; row counts unchanged (nothing written). Harness attempt r1 failed on the harness's own extra connection (kept, $RUN_DIR/licence-world/r1.log)
